messages:
Ana: Morning — quick async standup. Done: merged routing + rollout spec (PR linked), synced with sales on SLA language. Blockers: still waiting on perf numbers for the small-seq model variant; need QA signoff for regression tests (ping @Jules). Today: finalize canary traffic target, cut release notes, ping infra for reserved slot.

Mike: I can run perf once CI finishes. Will test with batch_size=8 and 16, post numbers here. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/312 — LGTM on the spec overall.

Lex: Noticed a session-stickiness edge case in load tests — when a node drains mid-request, tokens get duplicated in logs. Adding a unit test and a small fix. Might affect canary if not fixed.

Sam: I can do QA signoff after 3pm PT. Where are the canonical test vectors?

Ana: Test vectors live in the spec doc (notion): https://notion.so/rw/launch-test-vectors. @Sam thanks — please run the regression set and post failures.

Jules: On review now, will prioritize the regression checklist. Expect comments in the next hour.

CI-bot: Build #412 completed: unit tests passed. Integration tests failed on staging (see tail of logs):
```
ERROR: upstream-timeout when calling /v1/generate
Trace: TimeoutError at transport layer
```
Repro command: `./scripts/run-integ --staging --concurrency 50`

Mike: Initial perf (local p4d test): batch=16 => 95th=130ms, QPS=780. batch=8 => 95th=115ms, QPS=820. Looks like smaller batch helps latency with small-seq.

Ana: Decision proposal: canary with batch_size=8, route 10% traffic, rollback to smaller model variant on >3% error or 95th latency breach >150ms for 5m window. Opinions? :thinking_face:

Lex: +1 for batch=8. I'll include the rollback policy in the PR. Also pushing the session-stickiness fix now.

Sam: Approved for canary with QA smoke at 14:30 PT. I'll post results and any failing prompts.

Jules: Reviewed and left 2 minor comments. Not blocking.

CI-bot: Canary rollout started at 1699990300. Canary health: initial checks ok, integration test failures still present on a small subset — tagging @eng-runtime.

Ana: Thanks all — I'll update the release notes with the canary plan and the rollback thresholds. Ping me directly if you see anything noisy in the next hour. :thumbsup:
